assertion.statement: The actual D210 quaternionic surface has potentially good reduction everywhere, and E=L(A[11]) is Galois over Q with [E:Q]<2^66; A has good reduction over E at every residue characteristic different from11.
assertion.objects: The actual A/L with rational quaternion division action and all geometric Hom over the normal fiber field L, its full11-torsion field E and the semistable special-fiber torus.
assertion.hypotheses: The D210 normalizer and same-L Hom construction are supplied. The published semistable reduction and full-torsion criteria, Neron extension property and torus structure are retained. The normalizer maps can be scaled prime to11 using the split maximal order at11.
assertion.quantifiers: Every place of A, and every conjugate of the full torsion field E; the good-reduction conclusion over E is for residue characteristics other than11.
assertion.parameter_range: Dimension two, division quaternion algebra B of discriminant210, degree[L:Q]≤576 and auxiliary prime11.
assertion.uniformity: The same Galois field E suffices simultaneously at2,3,5,7; no unbounded new extension is used for the later degree estimate.
assertion.normalizations: A positive torus rank t≤2 would give an injective unital B→M_t(Q), impossible for t=1 by dimension and for t=2 by division versus split algebra. Prime-to11 isogenies identify conjugate11-torsion kernels over L.
assertion.exceptional_cases: The full-torsion reduction criterion is not applied at residue characteristic11. Potential good reduction alone does not imply the explicit field E is Galois; that uses normalizer maps prime to11.
assertion.limit_order: Pass temporarily to semistable reduction and exclude torus rank; construct prime-to11 conjugate isogenies over L; prove E is Galois and bound its degree; apply the full11-torsion criterion and torus argument.
